auth.noAccount: No account? Ask someone in the crew for an invite link.
auth.joiningAs: After you log in, you join the crew from the invite.

join.title: Join {{crew}}
join.formBody: You use it to log in from any phone.
join.displayNameHint: This is how the crew sees you.
join.usernameHint: You log in with it. Letters, digits, dots or dashes.
join.accountBody: You are logged in as {{username}}. Pick the name the crew sees.
join.expired: The link has expired. Ask whoever invited you for a new one.
join.used: The link was already used. Ask whoever invited you for a new one.
join.notFound: The link doesn't exist or was cancelled. Ask whoever invited you for a new one.
join.alreadyBody: This link is for someone new. You can pass it on.

home.noChallengeBody: When someone in the crew publishes one, you see it here.
home.noCrewTitle: You're not in a crew yet
home.noCrewBody: Ask someone in a crew for an invite link.

crew.title: Crew
crew.inviteBody: Send the link or show the code. They pick a name and a password and join the crew right away.
crew.revokeBody: The link {{code}} will stop working. You can send a new one any time.

errors.server_error: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
errors.invalid_credentials: The username or password doesn't match.
errors.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait a minute.
errors.csrf_failed: Your session expired. Reload the page.
errors.invite_expired: The link has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.invite_used: The link was already used. Ask for a new one.
errors.invite_not_found: This invite link doesn't exist or was cancelled.
errors.display_name_taken: Someone in the crew already uses this name.
errors.already_signed_in: You're already logged in. Log out to create another account.
errors.not_crew_member: You're not in a crew yet.
errors.not_crew_admin: Only a crew admin can do this.

pwa.updateReady: A new version of the app is ready.
pwa.installBody: Put it on your home screen: it opens like an app and can send you notifications.
pwa.iosTitle: Add it to your Home Screen
pwa.iosStep1: Tap the Share button in Safari's toolbar
pwa.iosHint: The Share button is in the bottom bar (at the top on iPad).

welcome.title: Welcome, {{name}}
welcome.checkInTitle: You check in on the challenge
welcome.checkInBody: With a photo or a video, when it asks for one.
welcome.crewTitle: You see who checked in today
welcome.crewBody: The whole crew sees check-ins and proof.
